source.title: Granny Dahnie - Forest Guardian
source.name: Granny Dahnie
source.description: A Wilder Tank who owns Glimmerbloom equipment, can absorb enemies' Energy, and can reduce enemies' Haste when taking damage.

skills.name: Threshold of Jade

description.raw: Granny Dahnie summons Parasitic Grass within 2 tiles for 3s. Every second, enemies within range cannot move or act and lose 25 + 5 (SP-based) Energy and at least 60% (ATK-based) HP. The total amount of their lost HP is 130% (ATK-based). Granny Dahnie also recovers an equal amount of HP. She is unaffected while Parasitic Grass exists.
active: Granny Dahnie summons Parasitic Grass within 2 tiles for 3s.
Every second, enemies within range cannot move or act and lose 25 + 5 (SP-based) Energy and at least 60% (ATK-based) HP.
The total amount of their lost HP is 130% (ATK-based).
Granny Dahnie also recovers an equal amount of HP.
She is unaffected while Parasitic Grass exists.

text: The total amount of enemies' lost HP is increased to 140% (ATK-based) per second, and each enemy's minimum HP loss is increased to 65% (ATK-based).
The Energy loss per second of enemies in range is increased to 35 + 5 (SP-based).
The total amount of enemies' lost HP is increased to 150% (ATK-based) per second, and each enemy's minimum HP loss is increased to 70% (ATK-based).
The total amount of enemies' lost HP is increased to 160% (ATK-based) per second, and each enemy's minimum HP loss is increased to 75% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Granny Dahnie summons Parasitic Grass to immobilize the enemies in range, absorb their HP and reduce their Energy. She is immune to control effects during the effect.

skills.name: Seed Cannon

description.raw: When an enemy deals total damage equal to 15% of Granny Dahnie's max HP to her, Granny Dahnie shoots Parasitic Seeds at this enemy, dealing 120% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage and reducing their Haste by 40 for 6s.
active: When an enemy deals total damage equal to 15% of Granny Dahnie's max HP to her, Granny Dahnie shoots Parasitic Seeds at this enemy, dealing 120% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage and reducing their Haste by 40 for 6s.

skills.description_lite: When an enemy deals a certain amount of total damage to Granny Dahnie, she attacks them back with Parasitic Seeds, reducing their Haste.

skills.name: Angry Taunt

description.raw: Granny Dahnie taunts an enemy for 3s and instantly recovers 140% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) HP. This skill prioritizes the enemy who targets the weakest ally.
active: Granny Dahnie taunts an enemy for 3s and instantly recovers 140% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) HP.
This skill prioritizes the enemy who targets the weakest ally.

skills.description_lite: Granny Dahnie taunts an enemy and recovers HP.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Granny Dahnie increases her Vitality by 11 during battle. She gains an extra 3 Vitality while casting Threshold of Jade.
active: Granny Dahnie increases her Vitality by 11 during battle.
She gains an extra 3 Vitality while casting Threshold of Jade.

text: Granny Dahnie increases her Vitality by 15 during battle.
She gains an extra 4 Vitality while casting Threshold of Jade.
Granny Dahnie increases her Vitality by 19 during battle.
She gains an extra 5 Vitality while casting Threshold of Jade.

skills.description_lite: Granny Dahnie's Vitality increases during battle. She gains extra Vitality while casting Threshold of Jade.

skills.name: Glimmerbloom Blessings

description.raw: When Granny Dahnie's HP ratio is lower than 50%, the Glimmerbloom Shield grows bigger, increasing her Phys DEF by 50% and Magic DEF by 50% and recovering 100% (ATK-based) HP every second. The skill lasts 12s and can be cast once every battle.

text: Gains unaffected when skill takes effect.

skills.description_lite: When Granny Dahnie's HP is low, she gains Phys DEF, Magic DEF, and recovers HP.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Granny Dahnie recovers 120% (ATK-based) HP when shooting seeds using Seed Cannon.
active: Granny Dahnie recovers 120% (ATK-based) HP when shooting seeds using Seed Cannon.
